---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Phase Flag
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing. What are you trying to accomplish?

_Example: I need to target flags by company plan tier, but the current rule builder only supports user-level attributes._

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of the solution you would like. If you have a specific API or UI design in mind, sketch it out here.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered. Why do they fall short?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or references to similar features in other tools that would help clarify the request.

---

> **Note:** For general questions or discussion about potential features, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/phase-flag/phaseflag/discussions) instead of opening an issue.
